SELECT s.symbol_id
FROM code.symbols s
WHERE s.kind = 'class'
  AND s.file_id = 'httpx/_exceptions.py'
  AND s.symbol_id NOT IN (
    SELECT cb.base_symbol_id
    FROM code.class_bases cb
    WHERE cb.base_symbol_id IS NOT NULL
      AND cb.base_symbol_id LIKE 'httpx/_exceptions.py::%'  
  )
  AND s.symbol_id NOT IN (
    SELECT s2.symbol_id
    FROM code.symbols s2
    WHERE s2.kind = 'class'
      AND s2.file_id != 'httpx/_exceptions.py'
      AND s2.qualname LIKE 'httpx._exceptions.%'
  )
ORDER BY s.symbol_id;

request:
Which classes defined in httpx/_exceptions.py are not subclassed by any other class anywhere in the repository (tests included)? Give their symbol IDs.

Requested output columns: symbol_id (string).
explanation: The query selects class symbols from httpx/_exceptions.py that do not appear as a base class in class_bases (internal or external) and are not referenced as a parent in any other class's qualname across the repository, ensuring they are truly un-subclassed.

FROM code.symbols s
WHERE s.kind = 'class'
  AND s.file_id = 'httpx/_exceptions.py'
  AND s.symbol_id NOT IN (
    SELECT cb.base_symbol_id
    FROM code.class_bases cb
    WHERE cb.base_symbol_id IS NOT NULL
      AND cb.base_symbol_id LIKE 'httpx/_exceptions.py::%'  
  )
  AND s.symbol_id NOT IN (
    SELECT s2.symbol_id
    FROM code.symbols s2
    WHERE s2.kind = 'class'
      AND s2.file_id != 'httpx/_exceptions.py'
      AND s2.qualname LIKE 'httpx._exceptions.%'
